Weakness.Name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
Weakness.Description: The product constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input.

Mitigation.Description: If at all possible, use library calls rather than external processes to recreate the desired functionality.

Description.xhtml:p: Use an allowlist of acceptable inputs.

Mitigation.Description: Run the code with the lowest privileges required.

Weakness.Name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
Weakness.Description: The product constructs a command using externally-influenced input.

Mitigation.Description: Properly quote arguments and escape special characters.

Weakness.Name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
Weakness.Description: The product does not properly control the allocation and maintenance of a limited resource.

Mitigation.Description: Design throttling mechanisms into the system architecture.

Weakness.Name: Unprotected Alternate Channel
Weakness.Description: The product protects a primary channel, but it does not use the same level of protection for an alternate channel.

Mitigation.Description: Identify all alternate channels and use the same protection mechanisms as for the primary channel.

Weakness.Name: Out-of-bounds Write
Weakness.Description: The product writes data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.

Mitigation.Description: Use a language that does not allow this weakness to occur.

Description.xhtml:p: Run or compile the software using features that provide automatic protection.
